title: Basie's Kansas City band and the musicians' hotel in New York
summary: Welburn asks about Herschel Evans and Lester Young; McRae recalls the hotel on 7th Avenue where musicians stayed.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Did you get a chance to see and hear Herschel Evans with that band?
(inaudible). The battles they used to have?
That's what I'm saying, all these fellas was around. We all lived -- we stayed in the hotel up there on 7th Avenue. What's that guy had that hotel up there on 42nd Street and 7th Avenue?
Yeah. You know, 41st Street there and 7th Avenue -- a big hotel that's been up there for years, (inaudible) colored fella owned it. All the musicians stayed in there.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Well, see, Herschel Evans and all the guys stayed together. Prez, Billie, (inaudible) but everybody stayed up there when they were in town -- those that didn't live down 116th Street, at that hotel down there.
